environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow exposed via API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with no access restrictions. The StartExecution API is invoked by a public-facing POST /process-token endpoint with Lambda proxy integration. API Gateway stage has no resource policy, no API key requirement, and no usage plan. The Step Functions execution result (including error_type differentiation) is returned synchronously via a DescribeExecution polling loop in the integration Lambda. CloudWatch logs are enabled but no alerting on repeated failures.
